decisions.reason: As the firm's flagship seasonal product with a renewed gold-medal quality signal, its value is largely revealed and the case for abandonment remains very weak.
This seeded rye mixed bread is a close, low-cost extension of the core assortment, and its survival past the first review suggests enough traction to keep the option open.
Although the dark barley malt rye bread remains somewhat niche, it has already survived earlier portfolio pruning and can be retained at limited incremental cost while demand continues to prove out.
The marzipan Christmas stollen fits a German bakery's seasonal range well, and absent any negative market signal it is worth retaining alongside the flagship raisin stollen.
